title: Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe has hamstring issue, hopeful of returning for Clasico vs Barcelona
content:
Real Madrid have confirmed that Kylian Mbappe has suffered a hamstring injury but the forward is targeting a return against Barcelona in the Clasico on May 10.

The 27-year-old was substituted during his side’s 1-1 draw with Real Betis on Friday, with club sources – speaking on the speaking on the condition of anonymity – afterwards indicating that the France international had suffered a left hamstring strain.

Further tests carried out on Monday have since confirmed that prognosis.

“Tests carried out today on our player Kylian Mbappe by the medical staff of Real Madrid have confirmed an injury to the semitendinosus muscle in his left leg. His recovery will depend on how the injury evolves,” Madrid said in a statement.

Club sources, speaking on the condition of anonymity, said Mbappe was targeting a return against Barca at the Camp Nou but would miss Madrid’s next game – another visit to Barcelona to face Espnayol on Sunday, May 3.

Mbappe has contended with a left knee problem over the course of this season, having a series of short-term spells out of the side because of the issue.

Despite the ongoing injury problems, he has still had an impressive individual campaign, scoring 41 goals in 41 games in all competitions.

On Thursday, it was confirmed that Mbappe’s Madrid team-mates, Turkey midfielder Arda Guler and Brazil defender Eder Militao, were set to be sidelined for the remainder of the season with hamstring injuries.

Real Madrid, now 11 points behind league leaders Barcelona, look set to endure their second consecutive trophyless season.
